title: Trace
description: An ordered sequence of Events observed during one execution (a reproduction run, a workflow run, or a live incident window).

reproduction_ref.description: Set if this trace was captured while executing a Reproduction (post-MVP entity).

event_refs.description: Ordered list of Event ids belonging to this trace. Order is significant.

source.description: Which adapter/mechanism produced this trace (docs/portability.md translate_observation).
